verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose i le mauga o Sinai, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Fai atu ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia i latou, A outou oo i le nuu ou te avatu ai ia te outou, ona fai ai lea se sapati e mapu ai le laueleele i le ALII.

verses.en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.sm: E ono tausaga e te lulu ai saito i lou fanua, e ono tausaga e te teuteu ai lou tovine, ma faaputu ai ona fua.

verses.en: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.sm: A o le fitu o tausaga e fai ma sapati lea e mapu ai le laueleele, O le sapati i le ALII; aua e te lulu ai ni saito i lou fanua, aua foi e te teuteu ai lou tovine.

verses.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.sm: O mea e tutupu fua nai lau seleselegásaito, aua e te seleseleina, aua foi e te tau ni fua o lou vine ua le teua; o le tausaga lea e mapu ai le laueleele.

verses.en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
verses.sm: O le sapati o le laueleele e fai lea ma mea e ‘ai ma outou, O oe ma lau auauna tane, ma lau auauna fafine, ma le ua fai lau galuega i le totogi, atoa ma le tagata ese O loo awtan ia te oe;

verses.en: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.sm: Ma au manu fanua atoa ma manu o le vao o i lou nuu, e fai ma mea e ‘ai o mea uma e tutupu ai.

verses.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
verses.sm: Ia e faitauina tausaga faasapati e fitu, e fitu ni fitu o tausaga; o le atoatoa foi o tausaga faasapati e fitu, e fagafulu ma le iva ia tausaga.

verses.en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.sm: Ona ili ai lea o le pu ma le leo tele i le aso e sefulu o le fituga rhasina, i le aso o le togiola, ia outou ili ai le pu i lo outou nuu uma lava.

verses.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.sm: Ia outou faasaina le tausaga e limagafulu, ma tala‘i ai le saolotoga i lo outou nuu i e nonofo ai uma lava; e fai lea ma iupeli ia te outou, ma ia outou toe foi atu taitoatasi i lona lava fanua, ia outou toe foi atu foi taitoatasi i lona lava aiga.

verses.en: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
verses.sm: O le tausaga e limagafulu e fai lea ma iupeli ia te outou; aua tou te lulu ai ni saito, pe selesele ai mea e tutupu fua, pe tau ai ni fua o lou vine ua le teua.

verses.en: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.sm: Ana o le iupeli lea; e paia lava ia te outou; O mea e tutupu ai i le fanua ia outou aai ai.

verses.en: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.sm: O le tausaga foi o lea iupeli e toe foi atu ai outou e taitoatasi i lona lava fanua.

verses.en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
verses.sm: Afai foi e te faatau atu se mea i lè lua te tuaoi, pe faatau mai se mea ai le lima o lé lua te tuaoi, aua tou te faasaua le tasi i le tasi.

verses.en: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
verses.sm: E tusa ma le faitau o tausaga talu le iupeli ia e faatau mai ai i lē lua te tuaoi, e tusa foi ma le faitau O tausaga e fua mai ai, ia faatau mai ai o ia ia te oe;

verses.en: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
verses.sm: e tusa ma le tele o tausaga ia e faatele ai lona tau, e tusa foi ma le itiiti o tausaga ia e faaitiiti ai lona tau; aua e tusa ma le faitau o fuata e faatau mai e ia ia te oe.

verses.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: Aua lava tou te faasaua le tasi i le tasi; a ia e mataʻu i lou Atua; aua o aʻu o le Aw lo outou Atua.

verses.en: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.sm: Ia outou faia foi a‘u tulafono, ma tausiusi i aʻu faamasinoga, ma fai ai; tou te nonofo ai i le nuu ma le filemu.

verses.en: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.sm: E fua mai foi le fanua i ona fua, tou te aai ai, ma maoona ai, ma nonofo ai ma le filemu.

verses.en: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.sm: Afai foi tou te fai mai, O á mea matou te aai ai i le tausaga e fitu? faauta, matou te le luluina ni saito, pe faaputu ai ni a matou mea e tutupu.

verses.en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.sm: Ou te pule atu le manuia ia te outou i le ono o tausaga, ona fua mai ai lea i ona fua e tatau ma tausaga e tolu.

verses.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
verses.sm: Tou te luluina saito i lona valu o tausaga, ma aai pea lava i mea tuai seia oo lava i lona iva o tausaga; seia matua ni ona fua tou te aai pea lava i mea tuai.

verses.en: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.sm: E le faatauina le fanua, ia faato; aua e oʻu lava le fanau; aua o tagata ese outou ma E aumau ia te au.

verses.en: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.sm: O le nuu uma e fai mo outou, ia outou tuu atu ia toe faatauina le fanua.

verses.en: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.sm: Afai ua 00 ina mativa lou uso, ma ua faatauina atu e ia sona fasi fanua, afai foi ua alu ane se tasi o lona aiga e toe faatau mai ai, ona toe faatauina mai ai lea e ia le mea na faatauina atu e lona uso.

verses.en: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.sm: Afai ua le o ia te ia se tasi e toe faatauina mai, a ua maua e ia lava ni mea e tusa ma le toe faatau mai o le fanua;

verses.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.sm: ona faitau lea e ia o tausaga o lana faatau, ma toe avane ai o mea o totoe i le tagata na ia faatau atu ai; ona foi atu lea o ia i lona fanua.

verses.en: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.sm: A e afai ua le maua ni mea e lava ai ia toe faafoi mai ia te ia, ona tumau pea ai lea o le mea sa faatauina i le tagata na faatau mai ai, ina seia oo i le tausaga o le iupeli; ona tuuina atu ai lea pe a co i le iupeli, ona toe foi atu ai lea o ia i lona lava tofì.

verses.en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua faatauina atu e sc tasi se fale o i le aai ua i le loto ‘olo, E mafaia lava ia te ia ona toe faatau mai ai i lea tausaga atoa na ia faatauina atu ai; na te mafaia lava ona toe faatau mai ai manú o lei atoa le tausaga.

verses.en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua le toe faatauina mai ai ina o lei atoa le tausaga, ona tumau pea ai lea o le fale o i le aai ua i le loto ‘olo i le tagata na faatauina mai ai e au tupulaga; e le tuuina atu lea pe a oo i le iupeli.

verses.en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.sm: A o fale o i faoa aai ua le siomia i se ‘olo, e ta‘ua ia e pei o fanua i tua; e mafai ona toe faatau mai ai, e tuuina atu foi ia pe a oo i le iupeli.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.sm: Ae peitai ane o aai o sa Levi, o fale o i aai i lo latou fanua, e mafaia lava ona toe faatau mai e sa Levi i aso uma.

verses.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.sm: A faatau ai foi e se' tasi se mea a sa Levi, ona tuuina atu ai lea pe a oo i le iupeli o le fale sa faatauina, o le aai foi ua fai māna; auā o fale i aai a sa Levi o latou lava ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.sm: A o fanua i tuapa o a latou aai e le mafaatauina ia; aua o lo latou lava lea e faavavau.

verses.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua oo ina mativa lou uso, ua na le toe lava se mea; ona e fesoasoani ai lea ia te ia; e ui 19I lava o ia le tagata ese ma le aumau; ina ia nofo lava O ia faatasi ma oe.

verses.en: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.sm: Aua e te talia mai ia te ia se totogi, po o se mea E faasili; a ia e mataʻu i lou Atua; ina ia nofo lava lou uso faatasi ma oe.

verses.en: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
verses.sm: Aua e te avatu ia te ia au tupe e maua ai ni ona tupu; aua foi e te avatu ia te ia au mea e “ai ina ia toe maua mai se mea e faasili.

verses.en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
verses.sm: O aʻu o le Aw lo outou Atua, o le na au mai ia te outou nai le nuu O Aikupito e foai atu ai ia te outou le nuu o Kanana; ina ia fai a‘u mo outou Atua.

verses.en: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.sm: Afai foi ua oo ina mativa lou uso O loo nofo faatasi ma oe, ua na faatauina O ia e ia ia te oe, aua e te faapologa ia te ia e fai le galuega a le pologa.

verses.en: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
verses.sm: A ia i ai o ia ia te oe, e pei o le ua galue i le totogi, po o sé aumau, e auauna atu foi o ia ia te oe,

verses.en: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.sm: seia oo i le tausaga o le iupeli; 4r ona alu ese ai lea o ia ia te oe, o ia atoa ma ana fanau faatasi ma ia, e foi atu foi o ia i lona lava aiga, ma le fanua o ona tama e foi atu ai lava o ia.

verses.en: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.sm: Aua o au auauna i latou na ou aumaia nai le nuu o Aikupito; e le faatauina i latou e fai ma pologa.

verses.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.sm: Aua e te pule ia te ia ma le faasaua, a ia e mata‘u i lou Atua.

verses.en: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.sm: O ou pologa tane ma ou pologa fafine, mai nuu ese lava ia, o e vagavagai ia te outou; tou te faatau mai i latou, o pologa tane, ma pologa fafine.

verses.en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.sm: O fanau foi a tagata ese, o e ua āumau ia te outou, tou te faatau mai ai ni o latou, atoa ma ni o latou aiga o ia te outou o e na fananau mai i lo outou nuu; e fai foi i latou mo outou.

verses.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.sm: Tou te tofia foi i latou i a outou fanau pe a mavae atu outou, e fai mo latou tofi; e fai i latou ma pologa ia te outou e faavavau; a e peitai o outou uso o le fanauga a Isaraelu, aua tou te pule faasaua le tasi i le tasi.

verses.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
verses.sm: Afai foi e oo ina mauoa se tagata ese, po o se āumau o loo nofo faatasi ma oe, a o lou uso o loo nofo faatasi ma ia, ua 00 ina mativa, ua na faatauina atu foi o ia e ia i le tagata ese, po o le awnan o loo nofo faatasi ma oe, po o so le fanau a le aiga o le tagata ese;

verses.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.sm: a uma ona faatauina o ia e mafai ona toe faatauina mai; e mafai sona uso ona toe faatauina mai O ia;

verses.en: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.sm: E mafai lava e le uso o lona tama, po o le atalii o le uso o lona tama ona toe faatauina mai o ia; e mafai foi e se tasi o lona lava aiga ona toe faatauina mai o ia; o ia foi lava pe a mafai ia te ia, ia toe faatau o ia ia te ia.

verses.en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.sm: La te faitau foi ma le na faatau ia te ia talu le tausaga na faatauina ai o ia ia te ia e 00 lava i le tausaga o le iupeli; o tupe foi o lana faatau ia faatatauina i le faitau O tausaga, e pei o tausaga o le ua galue i le totogi e faapea lava ona fai ia te ia.

verses.en: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.sm: A ua tele tausaga o totoe, ia faatatau i ai le tau o lona toe faatauina mai e toe avane ai tupe na faatauina ai o ia.

verses.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua totoe na o nai tausaga itiiti ina seia co i le tausaga o le iupeli, ona la faitau ai lea ma ia, e faatatau i ona tausaga e toe avane ai e ia le tau o lona faatauina mai.

verses.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.sm: E ia te ia o ia e pei o se ua galue i le totogi i lea tausaga ma lea tausaga; aua le pule o ia ia te ia ma le faasaua i ou luma.

verses.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
verses.sm: Afai foi ua le toe faatauina mai o ia i nei tausaga, ona alu ese ai lea o iai le tausaga o le iupeli, o ia atoa ma ana fanau faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: Aua o aʻu auauna le fanauga a Isaraelu, o aʻu auauna lava i latou na ou aumaia mai le nuu o Aikupito; o aʻu o le AL lo outou Atua. O le taui o le faalogogata e
